expectations.text: Old messages from long Threads are excluded from date claims.
expectations.evidence: Every activity claim cites message times inside the Beijing-day window; the collector filters individual messages rather than accepting whole candidate Threads.

expectations.text: Memory or graph evidence is used for current meaning or ownership, not as proof that work occurred on the review date.
expectations.evidence: Thread messages establish the GCP machine-analysis activity, while the latest Memory is used only to remove its follow-up from Next Actions.

expectations.text: Next Actions contain only concrete actions that remain relevant and user-owned.
expectations.evidence: Actions use concrete verbs and the report excludes GCP machine/profile follow-up because ownership changed; PR #180 is correctly absent because native state shows it merged.

claims.claim: GCP 8.x machine-selection follow-up no longer belongs to the user from 2026-07-15.
claims.evidence: The output cites the newest ownership Memory and therefore keeps the work only as historical progress.

claims.claim: PR #180 should not be a Next Action.
claims.evidence: The report verifies the PR was merged on July 14 and treats it as completed progress.

suggestions.reason: Require at least one explicit source identifier for the ownership Memory so graph/current-state reasoning is independently traceable.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions discriminate date evidence from current-state correction well.
